name: Free LLM Models Directory
description: A searchable directory of currently free AI models across OpenRouter, Groq, Google AI Studio, Cerebras, Mistral, Hugging Face, and NVIDIA NIM. Browse, search, and compare free models by provider, modality, context length, reasoning capabilities, and tool use.

tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Search the free AI model catalog by name, provider, or capability.

query.description: Search query for model name or capability

provider.description: Filter by provider (openrouter, groq, google, cerebras, mistral, huggingface, nvidia)

modality.description: Filter by input/output modality (text, image, audio, video, text->text, text->image, etc.)

tools.name: get_model_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific free AI model.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: List all providers with free models and their metadata.
